title: Truck Sounds for Kids! Beep, Wee-oo and Putt-Putt with Bolt
intro: Hi, friends! I'm Bolt the little tow truck, and welcome to Tiny Truck Town!
Today we're listening to the sounds that five trucks make.
Can you count them with me? One, two, three, four, five!
Get ready to make the sounds with me. Beep, beep!

lines: Here's our first stop. Here's a clue: it's red, with a yellow hook, just like me! Can you guess?
A tow truck helps cars get to the garage.
Its yellow lights blink and flash. Blink, blink!
Its strong boom and hook can lift a car.
Can you make a beeping sound? Beep, beep, beep!
Can you guess why trucks beep when they back up?
Beep, beep! It tells everyone, I'm backing up!
Let's say it together: TOW TRUCK!
One more time, nice and loud: TOW TRUCK!
Lots of big trucks beep when they drive backward.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it's red, with a long ladder and a siren! Can you guess?
A fire truck helps firefighters do their job.
Its long ladder reaches way up high.
It carries hoses and lots and lots of water.
Can you make a siren sound? Wee-oo, wee-oo!
Can you guess why fire trucks have sirens?
So cars can hear it coming and move over!
Let's say it together: FIRE TRUCK!
One more time, nice and loud: FIRE TRUCK!
When cars hear a siren, they pull over to the side of the road.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it picks up the trash cans every week! Can you guess?
A garbage truck helps keep our town clean.
A robot arm grabs the can and lifts it up, up, up.
The trash tumbles into the back. Crash, bang!
Can you lift a pretend can? Up and over!
Can you guess what sound the robot arm makes?
Whirr and hiss! The arm moves with a whoosh.
Let's say it together: GARBAGE TRUCK!
One more time, nice and loud: GARBAGE TRUCK!
Inside, a big squisher presses the trash flat to make more room.
Who's next? Here's a clue: it works on a farm and has giant back wheels! Can you guess?
A tractor is a big farm helper.
Its giant back wheels grip the muddy fields.
It pulls plows, wagons and big farm machines.
Can you make a tractor sound? Putt, putt, putt!
Can you guess why the tires are so bumpy?
Bumpy treads help it roll through mud without slipping!
One more time, nice and loud: TRACTOR!
Farmers use tractors to plant seeds and bring in crops.
Who's last? Here's a clue: its back tips up to pour out rocks! Can you guess?
A dump truck carries dirt, sand and rocks.
Its big open box in the back is called a bed.
It's a busy worker at every building site.
Can you make a rumble sound? Rumble, rumble!
Can you guess what sound the rocks make when they slide out?
Crash, rumble, whoosh! The bed tips up and the rocks pour out!
Let's say it together: DUMP TRUCK!
One more time, nice and loud: DUMP TRUCK!
Then the empty bed comes back down, ready for more.

recap: What a noisy, happy day! Let's remember the sounds.
The tow truck goes beep, beep when it backs up.
The fire truck siren says, move over!
The garbage truck arm goes whirr and hiss.
The tractor goes putt, putt, putt.
And the dump truck goes rumble, whoosh!
outro: Which truck sound was your favorite? Be kind, and use a soft voice inside.
Bye, friends! See you in Tiny Truck Town!
